t_advice_summary_textbox.text: In order to achieve the best result choose the orange gnome with the small hat - although it does appear to be random

vb_textbox.text: The reward is not random - it is based on both the gnome vs gnome colour and also their position on the "s" and "k" side of the screen. I could not figure out which was more prosperous, however the "k" side of the screen seems to be more fruitful than the "s" side of the screen. Therefore if you can continuously choose "k" you will be successful.
